prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for all of Miami—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, and price range. Based on the available recent rankings and sales data, **Sandra Rathe (REAL)** is one candidate to interview: HomeLight lists her first among its Miami agents, with a 5.0 rating and 132 reviews. That ranking is a starting point, not a guarantee she’s the best fit for your property.

I’d interview **three agents who have recently represented sellers in your specific neighborhood and price range**. Ask each for:
- Recent comparable listings they sold, including original list price, final price, and days on market
- Their pricing rationale and marketing plan for your home
- Their commission and any other fees, in writing
- References from recent seller clients

You can also compare agent profiles and recent activity on [Realtor.com](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/miami_fl) and [Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/miami-fl/). If you share your neighborhood, property type, and approximate value, I can help narrow down what to look for.
